# Generated by Codex CLI 0.144.6 (GPT-6).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(neverball_xbox_renderer C)
# Apple's archive tools discard the COFF symbol index; use LLVM for NXDK.
find_program(NXDK_LLVM_AR NAMES llvm-ar REQUIRED)
find_program(NXDK_LLVM_RANLIB NAMES llvm-ranlib REQUIRED)
set(CMAKE_AR "${NXDK_LLVM_AR}")
set(CMAKE_RANLIB "${NXDK_LLVM_RANLIB}")
# Build the backend independently; Makefile.nxdk links its output libraries.
set(NXDK_GLES11_WITH_GL4ES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(RENDERER "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../build/deps/nxdk-gles11")
if(NOT EXISTS "${RENDERER}/CMakeLists.txt")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Run python3 scripts/bootstrap-xbox-renderer.py first")
endif()
add_subdirectory("${RENDERER}" renderer)
